I've passed your request on to our product team so they can consider it. I'm not able to share a release date for this feature or make any commitments about credits or free months, but your feedback is genuinely helpful. To help the team understand your needs, could you tell us a bit more about which data you'd like to export (for example, reports, lists or specific pages) and how you plan to use it in Excel? Could you also share the email address associated with your account? Thanks again for taking the time to write to us.
